overview: The Committee of the Whole held its second preliminary budget meeting for Fiscal Year 2027 to review the needs and goals of four city departments. The council discussed departmental transitions from ARPA funding, pending infrastructure projects, and the implementation of a city-wide compensation and classification study.

items.title: Human Resources Department Budget Review
items.summary: Director Lisa Crowley presented the HR budget, noting increases for advertising and training programs previously funded by ARPA. The council requested an executive summary of a recently completed compensation and classification study and a copy of updated salary schedules.

items.title: Council on Aging Department Budget Review
items.summary: Director Pam Kelly detailed a slight budget increase to expand social worker hours and highlighted successes in rebranding the senior center and managing food insecurity programs. Kelly stated her long-term goal of conducting a feasibility study for a new senior center building to accommodate the city's growing elderly population.

items.title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Office Budget Review
items.summary: Director Frances Nwajei discussed the necessity of moving a disability specialist and language access services from ARPA funding into the general budget as federal grants expire. The office is currently focused on internal facility compliance, reviewing development plans, and preparing for new federal web accessibility guidelines.

items.title: Recreation Department Budget Review
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey outlined new initiatives for teen programming and revenue generation at the LoConte Rink while reporting that contractual increases are driven by a settled Teamsters union agreement. The council discussed difficulties in hiring part-time staff and received an update on water mitigation efforts required for the recreation center's gym floor.

items.title: Upcoming Meeting Schedule and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee and Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian coordinated upcoming budget and zoning meeting dates. Approved keeping the budget item in committee and adjourning.

subject: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget Hearings
